properties.documentation: When enabled, will limit modes analyzed for each CU using cost metrics from the 4 sub-CUs. This can significantly improve performance when `rectangularMotionPartitionsAnalysis` and/or `asymetricMotionPartitionsAnalysis` are enabled at minimal compression efficiency loss.

properties.name: limitReferences
properties.documentation: If enabled, limit references per depth, CU or both.

properties.name: limitSao
properties.documentation: Limit SAO filter computation by early terminating SAO process based on inter prediction mode, CTU spatial-domain correlations, and relations between luma and chroma. Default false.

properties.name: limitTransformUnitDepthRecursion
properties.documentation: Enables early exit from transform unit depth recursion, for inter coded blocks. Default is DISABLED.

properties.name: lookaheadSlices
properties.documentation: Use multiple worker threads to measure the estimated cost of each frame within the lookahead. The higher this parameter, the less accurate the frame costs will be which will result in less accurate B-frame and scene-cut decisions. Valid range: 0 - 16

properties.name: lowpassDct
properties.documentation: Will use low-pass subband dct approximation instead of the standard dct for 16x16 and 32x32 blocks. Default false.

properties.name: masterDisplay
properties.documentation: Set the mastering display color volume SEI info (SMPTE ST 2086). For example `G(13250,34500)B(7500,3000)R(34000,16000)WP(15635,16450)L(10000000,1)` describes a P3D65 1000-nits monitor, where G(x=0.265, y=0.690), B(x=0.150, y=0.060), R(x=0.680, y=0.320), WP(x=0.3127, y=0.3290), L(max=1000, min=0.0001). Part of HDR-10 metadata. If used on a Dolby Vision stream, this value must be set to `G(13250,34500)B(7500,3000)R(34000,16000)WP(15635,16450)L(10000000,1)`.

properties.name: maxBitrate
properties.documentation: Maximum Bitrate (bps)

properties.name: maxContentLightLevel
properties.documentation: Set the max content light level (MaxCLL). Use together with maxPictureAverageLightLevel (which will be 0 if not set). Part of HDR-10 metadata.

properties.name: maxGop
properties.documentation: Maximum GOP length, the maximum distance between I-frames

properties.name: maximumTransformUnitSize
properties.documentation: Penalty for 32x32 intra transform units in non-I slices. Default DISABLED.

properties.name: maxKeyframeInterval
properties.documentation: Maximum interval in seconds between key frames

properties.name: maxMerge
properties.documentation: Maximum number of neighbor (spatial and temporal) candidate blocks that the encoder may consider for merging motion predictions. Valid range: 1 - 5

properties.name: maxPictureAverageLightLevel
properties.documentation: Set the maximum picture average light level (MaxFALL). Use together with maxContentLightLevel (which will be 0 if not set). Part of HDR-10 metadata.

properties.name: minBitrate
properties.documentation: Minimum Bitrate (bps)

properties.name: minCodingUnitSize
properties.documentation: Minimum CU size (width and height). By using 16 or 32 the encoder will not analyze the cost of CUs below that minimum threshold, saving considerable amounts of compute with a predictable increase in bitrate. This setting has a large effect on performance on the faster presets.

properties.name: minGop
properties.documentation: Minimum GOP length, the minimum distance between I-frames

properties.name: minKeyframeInterval
properties.documentation: Minimum interval in seconds between key frames

properties.name: modifiedAt
properties.documentation: Modified timestamp, returned as UTC expressed in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

properties.name: motionSearchRange
properties.documentation: Set the Motion search range.

properties.name: name
properties.documentation: Name of the resource. Can be freely chosen by the user.

properties.name: noiseReductionInter
properties.documentation: An integer value, which denotes strength of noise reduction in inter CUs. Default 0.

properties.name: noiseReductionIntra
properties.documentation: An integer value, which denotes strength of noise reduction in intra CUs. Default 0.

properties.name: openGop
properties.documentation: Enable open-gop, allows referencing frames from a previous gop

properties.name: pbRatio
properties.documentation: QP ratio factor between P and B slices. This ratio is used in all of the rate control modes. Default 1.3

properties.name: pixelFormat
properties.documentation: Describes the color encoding, bit depth, and chroma subsampling of each pixel in the output image.

properties.name: presetConfiguration
properties.documentation: Choose from a set of preset configurations tailored for common use cases. Check out [H265 Presets](https://bitmovin.com/docs/encoding/tutorials/h265-presets) to see which values get applied by each preset. Explicitly setting a property to a different value will override the preset's value for that property.

properties.name: psyRateDistortionOptimization
properties.documentation: Psycho-visual rate-distortion retains fine details like film grain at the expense of more blocking artifacts. Higher values make the video appear sharper and more detailed but with a higher risk of blocking artifacts. Needs to have subMe with RD_IP, RD_ALL, RD_REF_IP, RD_REF_ALL, QPRD or FULL_RD

properties.name: psyRateDistortionOptimizedQuantization
properties.documentation: Strength of psycho-visual optimizations in quantization. Only has an effect in presets which use RDOQ (rd-levels 4 and 5). The value must be between 0 and 50, 1.0 is typical

properties.name: qp
properties.documentation: Quantization factor

properties.name: qpMax
properties.documentation: Maximum quantization factor. Valid value range: 0 - 69

properties.name: qpMin
properties.documentation: Minimum quantization factor. Valid value range: 0 - 69

properties.name: qpOffsetChromaCb
properties.documentation: Offset of Cb chroma QP from the luma QP selected by rate control. This is a general way to spend more or less bits on the chroma channel. Default 0

properties.name: qpOffsetChromaCr
properties.documentation: Offset of Cr chroma QP from the luma QP selected by rate control. This is a general way to spend more or less bits on the chroma channel. Default 0

properties.name: qpStep
properties.documentation: The maximum single adjustment in QP allowed to rate control. Default 4

properties.name: quantizationGroupSize
properties.documentation: Enable adaptive quantization for sub-CTUs. This parameter specifies the minimum CU size at which QP can be adjusted. Default is same as `maxCTUSize`.

properties.name: quantizerCurveCompressionFactor
properties.documentation: Quantizer curve compression factor. It weights the frame quantizer based on the complexity of residual (measured by lookahead). Default 0.6

properties.name: rate
properties.documentation: Target frame rate of the encoded video. Must be set for live encodings

properties.name: rateDistortionLevelForModeDecision
properties.documentation: Level of rate-distortion optimization in mode decision. The lower the value the faster the encode, the higher the value higher the compression efficiency. Valid range: 0 - 4

properties.name: rateDistortionLevelForQuantization
properties.documentation: Specifies the amount of rate-distortion analysis to use within quantization.

properties.name: rateDistortionPenalty
properties.documentation: Penalty for 32x32 intra transform units in non-I slices. Default DISABLED.

properties.name: rcLookahead
properties.documentation: Number of frames for slice-type decision lookahead

properties.name: rectangularMotionPartitionsAnalysis
properties.documentation: Enable analysis of rectangular motion partitions Nx2N and 2NxN.

properties.name: recursionSkip
properties.documentation: If enabled exits early from CU depth recursion. When a skip CU is found, additional heuristics are used to decide whether to terminate recursion.

properties.name: refFrames
properties.documentation: Amount of reference frames

properties.name: refineRateDistortionCost
properties.documentation: Enable QP based rate distortion refinement. Default is disabled.

properties.name: sampleAspectRatioDenominator
properties.documentation: The denominator of the sample aspect ratio (also known as pixel aspect ratio). Must be set if sampleAspectRatioNumerator is set. If set then displayAspectRatio is not allowed.

properties.name: sampleAspectRatioNumerator
properties.documentation: The numerator of the sample aspect ratio (also known as pixel aspect ratio). Must be set if sampleAspectRatioDenominator is set. If set then displayAspectRatio is not allowed.

properties.name: sao
properties.documentation: Toggle sample adaptive offset loop filter

properties.name: saoNonDeblock
properties.documentation: Specify how to handle depencency between SAO and deblocking filter. When enabled, non-deblocked pixels are used for SAO analysis. When disabled, SAO analysis skips the right/bottom boundary areas. Default false.

properties.name: scenecutBias
properties.documentation: This value represents the percentage difference between the inter cost and intra cost of a frame used in scenecut detection. Default 5.0.

properties.name: sceneCutThreshold
properties.documentation: Scene Change sensitivity. The higher the value, the more likely an I-Frame will be inserted. Set to 0 to disable it.

properties.name: signHide
properties.documentation: Hide sign bit of one coefficient per coding tree unit.

properties.name: skipSplitRateDistortionAnalysis
properties.documentation: Enable skipping split rate distortion analysis when sum of split CU RD cost larger than one split CU RD cost for intra CU. Default disabled.

properties.name: slices
properties.documentation: Encode each incoming frame as multiple parallel slices that may be decoded independently. Default is 1.

properties.name: ssimRateDistortionOptimization
properties.documentation: It is used for mode selection during analysis of CTUs and can achieve significant gain in terms of objective quality metrics SSIM and PSNR. Default false.

properties.name: strictCbr
properties.documentation: Enables stricter conditions to control bitrate deviance from the target bitrate in ABR mode. Bit rate adherence is prioritised over quality. Default false.

properties.name: strongIntraSmoothing
properties.documentation: Enable strong intra smoothing for 32x32 intra blocks. Default true.

properties.name: subMe
properties.documentation: Set the amount of subpel refinement to perform.

properties.name: temporalMotionVectorPredictors
properties.documentation: Enable temporal motion vector predictors in P and B slices. Default true.

properties.name: transformSkip
properties.documentation: Enable evaluation of transform skip (bypass DCT but still use quantization) coding for 4x4 TU coded blocks. Default is NONE.

properties.name: type
properties.documentation: Discriminator property for CodecConfiguration

properties.name: videoFormat
properties.documentation: Specifies the source format of the original analog video prior to digitizing and encoding

properties.name: wavefrontParallelProcessing
properties.documentation: The encoder may begin encoding a row as soon as the row above it is at least two CTUs ahead in the encode process. Default is enabled.

properties.name: weightPredictionOnBSlice
properties.documentation: Enable weighted prediction in B slices

properties.name: weightPredictionOnPSlice
properties.documentation: Enable weighted prediction in P slices

properties.name: width
properties.documentation: Width of the encoded video in pixels

properties.documentation: Target bitrate for the encoded audio in bps (required)

properties.documentation: Channel layout of the audio codec configuration

properties.name: targetDurationRoundingMode
properties.documentation: The rounding applied to target duration. Two possible rouding modes exist: NORMAL_ROUNDING, when the target duration is rounded to the nearest integer, or UPWARDS_ROUNDING, when the target duration is rounded to the highest integer.

properties.name: disablePreannouncing
properties.documentation: Certain tags, such as EXT_X_DATERANGE, may be preannounced in the HLS manifest. This means they are inserted as early as possible, before the actual ad break begins or ends. Preannouncing helps clients anticipate upcoming splice points, but may cause compatibility issues with some downstream consumers (e.g., AWS MediaTailor SSAI). When this setting is enabled, preannouncing of tags is disabled, and tags are inserted at the segment corresponding to the event's splice time.

properties.name: enabledMarkerTypes
properties.documentation: Ad marker types that will be inserted. More than one type is possible.  - EXT_X_CUE_OUT_IN: Ad markers will be inserted using `#EXT-X-CUE-OUT` and `#EXT-X-CUE-IN` tags - EXT_OATCLS_SCTE35: Ad markers will be inserted using `#EXT-OATCLS-SCTE35` tags. They contain the base64 encoded raw bytes of the original SCTE-35 trigger. - EXT_X_SPLICEPOINT_SCTE35: Ad markers will be inserted using `#EXT-X-SPLICEPOINT-SCTE35` tags. They contain the base64 encoded raw bytes of the original SCTE-35 trigger. - EXT_X_DATERANGE: Ad markers will be inserted using `#EXT-X-DATERANGE` tags. They contain the ID, start timestamp and hex encoded raw bytes of the original SCTE-35 trigger. - EXT_X_SCTE35: Ad markers will be inserted using `#EXT-X-SCTE35` tags. They contain the base64 encoded raw bytes of the original SCTE-35 trigger.
